## Related Issue

Closes #ISSUE_NUMBER

## Related Pull Requests

List related open or closed PRs, or write "None".

## What Changed

Describe the resulting behavior and why this change is needed.

## Verification

List the commands or manual steps you actually performed,
and their results. Include screenshots when useful.

## Limitations or Blockers

Describe incomplete work, unavailable checks, or dependencies.
Write "None" if there are none.

## Author Checklist

- [ ] Changes address the linked issue's acceptance criteria and account for related PR work.
- [ ] I checked related PRs and noted whether each is open, merged, or closed without merge.
- [ ] I checked the changes for credentials and private data.
- [ ] I coordinated changes to shared files with their owners.
- [ ] I updated relevant documentation.
- [ ] I recorded the verification I actually performed.
- [ ] Backend, extension, staging integration, and hosted staging checks pass for the latest commit.
- [ ] I verified affected behavior in Chrome against that commit on staging and recorded evidence (or explained why the manual check is not applicable).
- [ ] I can explain my changes.
- [ ] I requested review from at least one teammate.
